title: PlummetAir
description: A paid message from PlummetAir. The cheapest way down.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-nasal
lines.text: Flying somewhere? <p:0.2> PlummetAir gets you there for nine dollars! <p:0.2> No seats, no doors, no second pilot. <p:0.2> Just you, the sky, and a firm handshake on departure. <p:0.2> PlummetAir, you'll land somewhere!

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Landing is a goal, not a guarantee. <p:0> Oxygen is a premium add-on. <p:0> The exit row is the entire plane. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
